key: For a spell, this was our last foodbank, but now it's dry too.
en: For a spell, this was our last foodbank, but now it's dry too.
ja: しばらくの間、ここが最後の食料備蓄だったんだが、もう底を突いた。

key: We even ate all the PokéSnax!
en: We even ate all the PokéSnax!
ja: ポケスナックスまで全部食っちまったよ!

key: So we'll get food after all, then?
en: So we'll get food after all, then?
ja: つまり、結局食料が手に入るってこと?

key: Why does it have to be now?!
en: Why does it have to be now?!
ja: 何でよりによって今なんだよ?!

key: I had just went through the trouble of scaven-- I mean, uh, salvaging this component from some of the heaters!
en: I had just went through the trouble of scaven-- I mean, uh, salvaging this component from some of the heaters!
ja: せっかく苦労して漁っ――いや、その、暖房機からこの部品を回収してきたばっかりだってのに!

key: I was gonna sell it so I could have GrubbinHub or DelibirdDash bring me something.
en: I was gonna sell it so I could have GrubbinHub or DelibirdDash bring me something.
ja: これ売って、アゴジムシハブかデリバードダッシュで何か届けてもらうつもりだったのに。
はぁ、あんなに苦労したのに……
お前! これ、持ってけ。

key: I don't even want to think about it anymore.
en: I don't even want to think about it anymore.

key: Whatever! Once I have delicious food, I won't even care anymore!
en: Whatever! Once I have delicious food, I won't even care anymore!
ja: もういい! 美味い飯にありつけりゃ、どうでもよくなるさ!
配給カードを、こちらへどうぞ。

key: No rations will be given without a card.
en: No rations will be given without a card.
ja: カードがなければ、配給はできません。
